source_native_info.source_basis: Native finite-volume average of original3mm piecewise-constant truth, Gauss in r²/theta, original40z layers
source_native_info.expected_gamma_split: original3mm integrals times original .114/.259 yields; never fitted observed counts
source_native_info.source_normalization: Native source normalized to probability mass for each energy; no gain fitted to data

source_higher_order_check.limitation: Same finite-volume averaging formula at higherquadrature; not an independent physical truth or voxelbasis convergence study. Registered generation/reconstruction still uses originalfrozenq64source.

truth_semantics: Original3mm source is evaluation/reference; modelgeneration uses its fixed finite-volume native approximation, shown separately
dose_semantics: Total expected emittedgamma budget, notAc225decays or detected counts; originalyields/sourceintegrals split energies
scientific_interpretation: 匹配原生矩阵合成数据在5e9/5e10也重现明显FOV边缘高值。在当前网格、视角、响应和无正则MLEM/背景估计流程下，Poisson采样即可形成这一类伪影，不需要真实Geant4输运与响应失配作为前提。提高到5e12后边缘高值显著减弱，但200次匹配原生源NRMSE仍为440约26.3%、218约24.8%，图像仍有模糊和小球对比不足。没有噪声实现集合、无噪声重建或独立网格实验，不能估计真实Geant4结果中各因素的因果贡献，也不排除已发现的物理响应失配。
